messages:
noah_sales: Prospect 'Argos' asking for a reserved commit + legal-approved fallback. Peak ~3000 RPS chat, mix ~60% short (~50 toks) / 40% long (~700 toks). They want AZ spread and a preheat/runbook.

ravi_se: Which model family? That decides GPU footprint and memory. Also confirm session KV behavior.

hana_ml: They plan 13B-distilled (4-bit) primary and 6B quantized fallback. Runtime numbers: 13B ~0.9M tok/s per GPU, 6B ~1.6M tok/s. Avg toks/request ~0.6*50 + 0.4*700 = 290 -> ~870k tok/s at 3k RPS. Ideal GPUs ~1.0. Ops margin -> recommend reserve 5 GPUs baseline spread across 3 AZs + 2 burst vGPU credits for short surges.

pete_ops: Autoscale & preheat notes: min_replicas=1/az, scale_up if util>75% for 30s, scale_down cooldown 5m. Preheat window 45m with synthetic ramp and KV priming using customer top-500 prompts. AZ spread suggested 2/2/1.

ravi_se: Sales line for contract: "Reserved GPUs: 5 baseline, 2 burst credits; preheat 45m; SLA 99.9% on provisioned capacity." Can finance price that vs pure burst?

hana_ml: Graceful degradation order: 1) route long responses to 6B in-region; 2) apply output truncation / reduce max_tokens; 3) route non-critical requests to hosted multi-tenant in secondary region; 4) return retry-after envelope. Ensure session_compat tags so state migrates safely.

sec_bot: Security paste-ready blurb: "Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure), encryption in transit and at rest. Audit logs can be forwarded to customer SIEM or S3 with configurable retention. Network isolation via VPC peering and private subnets."

noah_sales: Action items: Hana/Pete confirm perf doc + preheat checklist by EOD; Ravi draft pricing comparison (reserve5+burst2 vs reserve7) and I'll coordinate legal questionnaire insertion. Follow-up stand 09:30 PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
